verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a SaaS AI platform with chat history, uploaded documents, agents and an organization account, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents exporting user data such as conversations, Document Library files, agent configurations or account data, in open formats or otherwise. The open-weights and self-hosting statements are about model portability, not exporting your own data, so they are not credited here.
